description: Small representative RAG evaluation dataset (Sec. 25). Each case assumes the corresponding document (by title) has already been uploaded and ingested (status='ready') for the target org before running scripts/eval/run_rag_eval.py. This is a STARTER set (6 cases) meant to be extended, not a comprehensive benchmark - real coverage should grow alongside the actual knowledge base content once there is one.

cases.question: How long does a refund take to process?
How do I reset my password?
How can I cancel my subscription?
Can I export my data before deleting my account?
What is the capital of France?
Where can I download past invoices?
